title: Chrome Carrier Choir
description: A vowel formant layered over a metallic FM carrier, sung by something that isn't human. Pitch-envelope swoops drag each utterance up and down across the full register while vowels cycle and the FM index climbs, so the voice morphs from a low chrome groan into a piercing alien shriek over a 32-cycle pass.
code:
setcpm(116/4)
stack(
  note("<c2 g3 [eb4 c3] <a4 f2>>/2").s("fm")
    .fm(sine.slow(24).range(2, 13)).fmh("<1 1.5 3.5 0.5>/4")
    .vowel("<a e i o u o e>/3")
    .penv("<12 -7 19 -12>/8").pattack(0.02).pdecay(0.4).pcurve(1)
    .vib("<5 7 11>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.3, 2.2))
    .bpf(sine.slow(17).range(350, 4200)).resonance(16).ftype("ladder")
    .crush("<16 8 6 10>/16").shape(0.3)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.12, 0.88))
    .sometimesBy(0.15, x => x.speed(-1))
    .off(1/6, x => x.add(note(7)).vowel("i").gain(0.3).pan(0.2))
    .delay("0.45:0.375:0.65").room(0.6).gain(0.72)
)
